title: Utah Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & How to File
rank_math_title: Utah Small Claims Court (2026): $20,000 Limit & Fees
rank_math_description: Utah small claims in 2026: $20,000 limit (attorney fees included), $60-$185 fees, Online Dispute Resolution, 30-day service rule and 28-day appeals.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> justice court (defendant's home or where events happened) -> ODR or regular forms -> fee ($60/$100/$185) -> service (30 days before trial; ODR within 120 days) -> ODR/trial -> 28-day appeal ($240 + $10) -> supplemental proceedings / garnishment / lien
